# Pull Request Description

Use `docs/sdlc/<STORY-ID>/verification.md` and `code-review.md` as evidence.

Required sections:
- Summary
- Changes Made
- Test Evidence
- Known Limitations
- Reviewer Checklist

Do not claim passing tests or external actions unless tool output proves them.
